quotedRules.triggerAndResets:
The main feature of this slot is collecting Coins to trigger Respins and aiming to land high-value Jackpot Coins for bigger wins.
3 Respins are triggered when 5 or more Coins of any value land anywhere on the board during the base game.

All landed Coins remain locked in their positions while the empty cells Respin.
If one or more new Coin symbols land in any empty position, the remaining Respins are reset back to 3.
Respins end when no Coin lands during 3 consecutive Respins or when the entire board is filled with Coin symbols.
If the board becomes fully filled with Coins, the total win is multiplied by X2.

After the Respins finish, all Coin values are added together to determine the total Respin win.
quotedRules.plusOne:
When the +1 RESPIN symbol lands, the number of Respins increases to 4. Additionally, the +1 RESPIN symbol is assigned a random value of: 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 15X, or 20X.
Importantly, once +1 RESPIN symbol appears, every time another Coin lands, the Respins reset to 4 again.
quotedRules.regularValues: When landed, the golden regular Coin carries one of the following multiplier values relative to the bet:1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X, 7X, 8X, 9X, 10X, 15X, or 20X.
quotedRules.megaGrandGrouping:
To win the MEGA Jackpot, the player must land 2 MEGA Coins. If only 1 MEGA Coin lands, the MEGA Jackpot is not awarded. In this case, the value of the single MEGA Coin is 25X the bet.
If 2 MEGA Coins land, one MEGA Coin will have a value of 25X, and the second will have a value of 175X, for a total combined value of 200X the bet.
To win the GRAND Jackpot, the player must land 3 GRAND Coins. If only 1 or 2 GRAND Coins land, the GRAND Jackpot is not awarded. In this case, each GRAND Coin has a value of 50X the bet.
If 3 GRAND Coins land, the first GRAND Coin will have a value of 50X, the second 50X, and the third 900X, giving a total combined value of 1000X the bet.
